Directory research 2026-10-04: Booking email and phone are his booking agent's, as published on his own bookings page (203 area code). Both photos are site menu tiles with a caption band across the bottom ('TOUR DATES' / 'MIKE DELGUIDICE'); crop from the top or drop them if captions are not acceptable. X link given as x.com (site links twitter.com/mikedelguidice1).
description: Long Island singer and multi-instrumentalist who tours as a member of Billy Joel's band. With his own band (Big Shot) he plays Billy Joel songs, classic rock and pop covers, and his own songs, including the theme from the sitcom 'Kevin Can Wait'.
